title: Normalized scalar extension of a supported integral constant
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime and $i:X\to Z$ a closed immersion of arbitrary schemes. Extension of scalars from abelian pro-etale sheaves to discrete constant $\mathbf Z_\ell$-module sheaves [def-sfb-diagonal-system-interface] carries $i_*\mathbf Z_X$ to $i_*\mathbf Z_{\ell,X}$. There is an isomorphism $e$ whose scalar adjunction unit followed by the forgotten $e$ is the normalized supported integral generator of [def-sfb-cartier-reduction-data]. No residue coefficient, ordinary reduction presentation, invertibility hypothesis, or derived category is involved.

proof.text: For the lifted integer coefficient ring, the constant sheafification/forgetting comparison is an isomorphism and its hom is the normalized integral generator. Integer scalar forgetting is fully faithful, so it preserves the relevant Hom sets bijectively.

Use the normalized coefficient map from ULift(ZMod 0)=ULift(Z) to the p-adic ring. Evaluation at one proves its constant-source ordinary scalar-unit universal property. Finite direct image preserves that property. Compose its Hom bijection with lifted-integer forgetting and the preceding integral-source isomorphism; the generator-scalar identity identifies the composite with the supported integral generator.

Transfer the ordinary Hom universal property through the comparison inverse-image/direct-image adjunctions. The canonical closed supported source comparisons are invertible; the scalar-forgetting comparison is the transpose of the module comparison unit. Its unit formula identifies the transferred universal map with cartierProIntegralGenerator, retaining the exact generator rather than an unspecified automorphism.

Transpose the pro-etale generator through the insertion-of-one scalar adjunction. The resulting arrow is an isomorphism because precomposition induces a bijection on Hom into every p-adic sheaf. Its adjunction unit equation is exactly the required generator normalization.

lean.statement:
theorem supported_padic_scalar_extension (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    {X Z : Scheme.{u}} (i : X ⟶ Z) [IsClosedImmersion i] :
    ∃ e : (diagonalScalarExtension ℓ Z).obj
        ((lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} i).obj
          ((constantSheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj
            (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u + 1} ℤ)))) ≅
      (lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} ℤ_[ℓ])) i).obj
        (geoCartierConstant (ULift.{u + 1} ℤ_[ℓ]) X),
      HEq ((diagonalScalarAdjunction ℓ Z).unit.app _ ≫
        (diagonalForget ℓ Z).map e.hom)
        (cartierProIntegralGenerator (ULift.{u + 1} ℤ_[ℓ]) i)
